architecture: identical matched R0; HLV/physics and all additional mechanisms off; patient-relative z on; model_dim=32; heads=2; dropout=0.4; temporal/record pooling=mean; NEZ-positive logit

variants.A0: exact R0 masked weighted BCE: EZ=2, NEZ=1, aggregate channels in batch
variants.A1: per-patient weighted BCE with same EZ=2, NEZ=1; mean across active patients
variants.A2: A1 plus beta(epoch) times patient soft Macro-F1 on identical final logits

missing_true_class_soft_f1: zero, matching hard zero_division=0; class support must be audited before training

training.epoch_shuffle_seed: 42*100000 + fold*1000 + epoch; reset same RNG for A0/A1/A2 at each epoch
training.initialization: all model parameters bitwise-identical at epoch0 within each fold

development.fullval_selection: same rule using all 13; apparent metric is secondary

candidate_selection: A2 replaces primary A1 iff mean VLOO Macro-F1 delta >=0.005, A2 positive in >=3/5 folds, and mean VLOO EZ-F1 nondecreasing
outer_policy: No current outer labels, predictions, or result files may be read in development. Only after development and multiseed gates pass, freeze candidate fullval checkpoints/thresholds/hashes and evaluate outer once. R0/A1/A2 historical outer outcomes are not a selection input.
interpretation: Exploratory on a historically viewed cohort; never claim fresh sealed confirmation.
public_outputs: aggregate-only code/lock/CSV/JSON/Markdown; private patient rows, cache, logs and checkpoints stay off Git
